picks.editorial_note: A $334 million Schmidt Sciences grant to build new supercomputing infrastructure is one of the largest single AI-for-science funding commitments this week, materially expanding national research computing capacity.
picks.title: NCSA Joins the Schmidt Science Computing Network to Expand Advanced Computing for Scientific Discovery

picks.editorial_note: UC Berkeley and Berkeley Lab's companion Schmidt Sciences award establishing the Berkeley Science AI Platform at NERSC pairs major funding with a concrete new high-performance computing resource for researchers.
picks.title: UC Berkeley, Berkeley Lab collaboration with Schmidt Science Computing Network will Provide High Performance Computing for Cutting-Edge Research - NERSC: National Energy Research Scientific Computing Center

picks.editorial_note: A £39 million UKRI investment funding 20 Turing AI Fellows is a substantial national-scale bet on UK AI research capacity across diverse scientific domains.
picks.title: Turing AI Fellows set to strengthen UK’s AI capability | News | The University of Edinburgh

picks.editorial_note: Fermilab's multi-laboratory FemtoMind project applying agentic AI to lattice QCD calculations represents a genuine methodological advance at the frontier of fundamental particle physics.
picks.title: FemtoMind advances Genesis Mission at the proton scale

picks.editorial_note: HKUST's new Center for Marine Intelligence and its AI4Coral partnership with KAUST combine institutional investment with a concrete cross-border research collaboration applying AI to coral reef conservation.
picks.title: HKUST Establishes Center for Marine Intelligence and Partners with KAUST to Launch Inaugural AI4Coral Research Project
picks.university: Hong Kong Univ. of Science and Technology

picks.editorial_note: A Cambridge-led analysis finding a third of the global AI supply chain is invisible to governments has direct implications for export controls, national security policy, and AI governance debates.
picks.title: A third of the global AI supply chain is ‘invisible’ to governments

picks.editorial_note: A systematic review by MIT CSAIL and 17 other institutions cataloguing 95 scenarios for AI-driven catastrophic risk is a notable contribution shaping the policy and safety discourse around frontier AI.
picks.title: Researchers find eight ways AI could lead to our downfall

picks.editorial_note: Imperial College London and CNRS's new joint International Research Laboratory on AI-driven metabolism research formalizes a significant transatlantic academic partnership with dedicated infrastructure.
picks.title: Metabolism, AI and global health: Imperial and France's CNRS celebrate launch of joint laboratory

picks.editorial_note: DARPA's Triage Challenge Finals demonstrated autonomous systems and human-machine teams successfully performing disaster-victim triage, a tangible real-world validation of AI robotics under government sponsorship.
picks.title: DARPA Triage Challenge completes Finals event

picks.editorial_note: Michigan Tech and UCLA's finding that materials-prediction AI models need far less training data than assumed could meaningfully lower the cost and barrier to AI-accelerated materials discovery.
picks.title: Less Data, Faster Discovery: Researchers Rethink AI’s Role in Developing New Materials
